name: ssot-check
description: Find duplicated facts and report documentation drift.

interface.longDescription: Check documentation for copied facts that have gone stale. SSOT Check compares values against a curated source-of-truth manifest, reports exact file locations, and helps discover copies the manifest does not yet track. It also traces missing documentation pointers and unclear ownership across repositories. Audits propose fixes; requests to repair documentation authorize scoped edits. The bundled Python CLI requires Python 3.9 or later and has no third-party dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Check this repository for documentation drift.
Find repeated facts outside our SSOT manifest.
Trace missing pointers to maintained setup guides.
